items.title: Ernie Cagnolatti Interview, 1961-04-05
items.q: And Homer Eugene was in that outfit too at that time, playing guitar.

ctx.x: Oh, maybe I did hear him.
And Homer Eugene was in that outfit too at that time, playing guitar. And another fellow, I don't know if he's right now, they call him Titi. He used to play drum with Chris Kelly one time.
